summary.headline: Eureka Forbes Q2 FY27 revenue grew 15% to INR890 crore; adjusted EBITDA margin rose 43 bps to 13.6%, with a calibrated 3-4% price hike planned post-Diwali.
summary.overview: Q2 FY27 revenue rose 15% YoY to INR890 crore on top of a 14.9% base, with growth led by water purifiers (high teens) and emerging categories. Adjusted EBITDA grew 18.8% to INR120.7 crore and margin expanded 43 bps to 13.6%, driven by a 181 bps fall in opex ratio, while gross margin fell 138 bps to 55.1% on commodity inflation. H1 revenue grew 15.1% to INR1,590 crore, with flat H1 adjusted margin of 12.2%. Management flagged Q3 margin transition ahead of a mid-November price increase, with full-year margins targeted flat; H1 operating cash flow was negative on seasonal working capital.

segments.name: Water purifiers (AWP)
segments.commentary: Grew high teens YoY in Q2 with market share gains; sequential QoQ growth over 30%. Management said volume contribution was significantly higher than pricing.

segments.name: Product business
segments.commentary: Grew high teens YoY in Q2, with strong sequential growth led by water and emerging categories.

segments.name: Emerging categories (robotic vacuum, water softeners, air purifiers)
segments.commentary: Grew significantly faster than company average. Water softeners grew healthy double digits; 6 new Aeroguard air purifier SKUs launched ahead of the second-half season.

segments.name: Service (AMC and filters)
segments.commentary: AMCs were broadly flat versus Q1 trend after earlier AMC price increases of 3-10%; filter sales growth accelerated in Q2.

guidance_outlook: Management expects H2 revenue growth to step up and accelerate over H1's 15.1%, citing strong sell-out in Q2 and early festive period.
Calibrated price increase of 3-4% to be rolled out effective mid-November (post-Diwali) on water purifiers.
Q3 margins to see a transitionary impact as price increase lags cost inflation; full impact visible only in Q4, with margins expected to recover in Q4.
Full-year FY27 adjusted EBITDA margin targeted flat YoY.
Operating cash flow expected to be generated mainly in H2, as in FY26 when the entire year's operating cash flow came in H2.
capex_capacity: No capex or capacity figures were discussed on the call.
Pilot service projects to be scaled up over the next 3 to 6 months (not specified in detail).
demand_pricing: Water purifier price increases of around 5-6% were taken in April; no price increases since. AMC prices rose roughly 3-10%.
Management deliberately avoided pricing actions during the festive period to prioritise growth and customer acquisition.
Commodity inflation intensified in recent months across several inputs and is beginning to pressure gross margins.
Competitive intensity rising in water purifiers with new entrants; management claims significant H1 market share gain and presence across economy, mid and premium price points.
Inventory built ahead of BIS norm transition in Q2; management said Q2 tertiary and sell-out were in line with inventory, and no repeat of last year's single e-commerce partner issue is expected.

qa_highlights.question: Water purifier volume vs value split and how much more price is needed to restore gross margins?
qa_highlights.answer: Management did not give numbers; growth was volume-led with price contributing less. Planned price increase is 3-4% post Diwali, balanced against growth needs.

qa_highlights.question: Price hikes taken so far by category and service pricing?
qa_highlights.answer: Water up around 5-6% in April, no hikes since; AMC prices up roughly 3-10%.

qa_highlights.question: Why is service growth stable and what is working?
qa_highlights.answer: Service broadly in line with Q1 as price-increase effects persist. Initiatives include pre-filter check campaign, free customer-connect calls around 6 months post-AMC, and Express Care same-day (4-hour) service; filter growth accelerated.

qa_highlights.question: Is the 2-year and 4-year filter product a headwind to AMC growth?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said the products bring in first-time buyers, the 2-year filter has no grey market so conversion to AMC or filter is higher, and the filter business is insulated as it services the legacy base.

qa_highlights.question: Guidance change on revenue and profit growth?
qa_highlights.answer: H2 growth expected to step up over H1; full-year margin flat, with Q3 transitionary dip and Q4 recovery.

qa_highlights.question: Working capital and receivable days?
qa_highlights.answer: H1 working capital build is seasonal (festive inventory, modern trade and e-commerce on standard credit terms, BIS-related stock build); unwinding expected in H2.

qa_highlights.question: Promoter pledge impact on the stock?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said pledges are a matter between the promoter and lenders, with no impact on operations, governance or obligations to the company.

qa_highlights.question: Robotic vacuum traction and competitive intensity in water purifiers?
qa_highlights.answer: Management called robotics a market-leading category, citing multi-price portfolio, ODM partnerships, omnichannel network and over 3 million monthly D2C active users. In water purifiers it says it is the only brand across economy, mid and premium price points.

risks_watch: Gross margin pressure from commodity inflation; Q3 margin dip before Q4 recovery depends on the 3-4% price hike sticking.
AMC/service revenue still weak; 2-year and 4-year filter products could shift service revenue timing from AMCs.
Rising competition in water purifiers from new and digital entrants may pressure share and pricing.
Heavier A&SP spend (growing faster than revenue) may keep opex leverage under pressure.
H1 operating cash flow was negative; H2 unwinding of working capital must materialise.
Promoter share pledge activity and minority shareholder sentiment.
summary.management_tone: Confident on top-line momentum and market share, with clear emphasis on growth acceleration. Cautious and somewhat hedged on margins, flagging Q3 transitional pressure and commodity headwinds. Evasive on quantifying price/volume split, A&SP increase and service recovery timelines.
key_quotes: Our 15% revenue growth this quarter comes on top of 14.9% growth in Q2 last year.
Q2 margins were at lifetime high.
We do not expect a recurrence remotely of the issue that we faced last year.
As we look at the pricing in November, we are looking at a price increase range of between 3% to 4% to be rolled out post Diwali.

growth.why: Management guides H2 revenue growth to step up above H1's 15.1%, backed by strong Q2 sell-out, early festive demand, a 3-4% price hike from mid-November, and six new Aeroguard SKUs, but no capacity additions or order figures were given and full-year EBITDA margin is guided flat.

rows.label: Margin expansion
rows.when: Q3 FY27 dip, Q4 FY27 recovery
rows.why: Q2 adjusted EBITDA margin rose 43 bps to 13.6% but gross margin fell 138 bps to 55.1% on commodity inflation; management guides Q3 transitional dip and full-year FY27 margin flat, so expansion depends on the 3-4% price hike sticking.

rows.label: Capacity expansion / commissioning
rows.why: No capex or capacity figures were discussed; only pilot service projects to scale up over 3-6 months, unspecified.

rows.label: Volume growth
rows.why: Management guides H2 revenue growth to step up above H1's 15.1%, with water purifiers growing high teens in Q2 on share gains and volume contributing more than price.

rows.label: New capex announcement
rows.why: Capex was not discussed and no utilisation figure was given on the call.

rows.label: Guidance upgrade
rows.why: Management expects H2 growth to accelerate over H1's 15.1% on strong Q2 sell-out and early festive demand, but full-year margin is held flat, so an upgrade is more likely on revenue than on profit.

rows.label: Guidance downgrade
rows.why: Commodity inflation is pressing gross margin (down 138 bps to 55.1%), Q3 margin dips before the Q4 recovery, and A&SP spend is rising faster than revenue; the price hike must stick to hold the flat full-year margin.

rows.label: New product launch
rows.why: Six new Aeroguard air purifier SKUs launched ahead of the second-half season, and emerging categories (robotic vacuum, water softeners, air purifiers) are growing well above the company average.

rows.label: Calibrated 3-4% water purifier price hike post-Diwali
rows.why: Management guided a 3-4% increase effective mid-November after 5-6% taken in April, and full margin impact is expected only in Q4 as it lags cost inflation.

rows.label: H2 unwind of working capital and operating cash flow
rows.why: H1 operating cash flow was negative on seasonal inventory build; management expects operating cash flow to come mainly in H2, as in FY26 when the full year's operating cash flow arrived in H2.

rows.label: AMC and filter service revenue recovery
rows.why: AMCs were broadly flat vs Q1 after 3-10% AMC price increases, while filter sales growth accelerated in Q2; the 2-year and 4-year filter products could shift service timing.

tone.note: Management was confident on top-line momentum, market share and H2 growth acceleration, but cautious on margins with Q3 transition and commodity headwinds; analysts pressed on price/volume split, service recovery and competition, which management did not quantify.
